120th Episode: Why Hairan? (11)
The shattered debris of Gruenil couldn't even fall to the ground.
It was because of the sword energy filling the black sky. The fragments swept away by the sword energy turned into dust, and the commander couldn't maintain his shape like scattering smoke.
'It's over.'
Now that the Dragon Knights have arrived, there will be no reversal of the situation.
Jin made such a judgment. Unless Zipple suddenly sends reinforcements to Kinzelo or the Vermont royal family betrays, there can be no reversal.

The alliance between Zipple and Kinzelo had been broken long ago, so there was no hope for the former, and the latter was the same. Although the Dragon Knights belonged to Hairan, the command was held by the emperor.
It was the result of the royal family restraining Hairan for generations. The Dragon Knights had come to protect their homeland by the emperor's command.
'Before escaping, we must inflict as much damage as possible.'
Even with the Dragon Knights participating, it was impossible to completely annihilate Kinzelo at this place today. They must have prepared an escape route while attacking Hairan.
Kwadudeuguk...!
The fiercely spinning fireball stopped moving. As if a giant had taken a bite, a huge semicircle appeared where the fireball had been, near the front of Gruenil.
Soon after the flames completely disappeared, Jin wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
There was no need to worry about backflow anymore. From now on, all Jin had to do was watch the fight.
On the ground, Linpa and the Dragon Knights continued to press Belekt. The once healed bulky body was covered with wounds again.
However, Belekt proved to be one of the world's top fighters, and it wasn't easy to land a decisive blow.

The Dragon Knights were breaking into the shattered Gruenil. They couldn't easily enter due to the resistance of Kinzelo's party inside the ship and the ship's structure, but it seemed to be only a matter of time.
A moment later, Jin was able to confirm that the commander, whose body was being torn apart, suddenly reappeared at the front of Gruenil.
The scattered blurry energy formed a body in front of the ship. It was undoubtedly an action to prevent the Dragon Knights from entering the interior.
Also, the process seemed quite fast, as the newly formed commander's body trembled like a persimmon tree.
'It seems like he's pushing himself? To protect Gruenil.'
Not only Jin but everyone who saw the scene felt that way.
'To be precise, it's not Gruenil, but the passengers he's trying to protect.'
Everyone aboard Gruenil was the core member of Kinzelo.
The chaos sculptor Bubar, the deputy commander Bishkel, the engineer Cho for the development of the Myungin, and Marjiella.
Marjiella's exact abilities were unknown, but considering her treatment, it seemed unlikely that she was just Bishkel's sister. She also seemed to be related to chaos.
"Dragon Knights in the air, attack the ship all at once!"

As Ron gave the order, the Dragon Knights simultaneously concentrated and formed ranks. The lined-up dragons in breakthrough formation rushed in, and the sharp sound of breaking the wind pierced their ears.
Jin had already reflected the great magic, so it seemed that the knights would be able to destroy Grenil in an instant.
But at that moment.
Everyone on the battlefield had to realize that the power of the Kinzelo leader was not all that had been shown so far.
The leader's once blurry body suddenly became darker.
Blood-red eyes revealed a distinct glow. It was not a look with special energy or spirit, but it gave an indescribably ominous feeling.
The leader's steel sword caused a flash in the middle of the air, and seeing the sword energy extending from the sword,
Jin couldn't help but gasp.
'Luna Nunim's... heart sword!?'
The red sword energy.
It was the sword energy Jin had seen only once before when Luna used the Demon Stone to cut Andrei Zipple.

Although it wasn't exactly the same shape as Luna's 'Heart Sword Red Moon' at the time, the red sword energy displayed by the leader definitely resembled Luna's sword. It could be believed to be the same person's sword.
"Be careful!"
"Block it!"
Ron and the Knight Commander shouted simultaneously.
The dragons twisted their bodies sharply, and the knights unfolded sword barriers instead of sword energy.
The leader's sword energy showed tremendous power, tearing the sword barriers of the top knights of Hairan like paper. It was not just superficially similar to Luna's sword.

Fortunately, there were no knights who lost their lives or suffered fatal injuries from the red sword energy. However, the red sword energy passed through the knights and only stopped its progress after touching Rashid's radiance.
'Did Luna Nunim cut the demon when she saved Orgal's pendant? Could the leader of Kinzelo be the demon related to that?'
There was no way to verify it immediately.

The knights, who had almost initially entered the ship's interior, were being pushed back again. Those who were too close had their dragon's wings torn by the continuous red sword energy the leader spread.
Kiaaaak-!
Other knights followed, descending to save the crashing dragon.
At that moment, Jin unknowingly clenched his fist tightly. It was because such a skilled leader had created an opportunity that could not be missed.
'There will be cracks in the ranks of the knights.'
Losing a formation in such a melee could be more devastating than one might think. Especially if they lost the dragons, it would be inevitable to lose their aerial combat capabilities.
However, the leader could not push the sword energy into the gap.
Staggering...!
On the contrary, the leader showed a sign of overexerting his power. It was an exposed weakness that should never be shown to the enemy.
As expected from the beginning, the leader was not in perfect condition.
But would that really be good news for Jin and his colleagues, and for all those who had to fight against Kinzelo?
It was a question that could be confidently denied.
'Even now, barely maintaining the overall body with its unique power, if it can show such monstrous strength, when it fully recovers later...'
It was hard to even imagine how strong that would be.
'Maybe it's a person who won't be lacking even when compared to my father.'
Excluding the divine beast Vahn and Temar, no one had ever left such an impression on Jin. The power the leader showed was that shocking.
Whooong-!
Murakan charged towards the leader with Ron on his back. The leader was staggering in mid-air, having missed the gap between the knights.
Of course, even that was only an extremely short moment.
But if the ones charging into that gap were the black dragon Murakan and the Sword Emperor Ron, the story could be different.
[Destroy, Ron Hairan!]
Murakan wrapped his body with a protective shield formed by his spirit energy.
It was a shield to protect himself from Ron's sword. Also, the shield acted as a kind of curtain, obscuring the leader's view.
Ron's whole body glowed with radiance.
As he leaped on Murakan, a dazzling light filled the area.
Imperial Sword Secret Skill
Sun
It was the secret skill Dante unfolded against the monster in the castle.
However, Ron's Sun and Dante's Sun were only the same in name, and of course, the level of their swords was different.
Hwaaaak-!
The aura light from Ron literally formed a sphere like the sun. The leader, as well as the ship Grenil, seemed to be buried in the sphere.
The knights who saved their crashing comrades also rejoined. Their role was to form a safe zone so that the power of the secret skill Sun wouldn't spread to the allies on the ground.

Despite the knights filtering it out, deep and huge craters were forming in various places on the ground. The shockwave alone caused vibrations throughout the earth's crust, and the collapsed Sword Emperor's castle shook precariously as if it would completely collapse.
Deafening noise, a dazzling light that stabbed the eyes like a finely honed blade.
It seemed impossible for any living being to come out alive from the Sun unfolded by Ron. Tens of thousands of blades fired inside the sphere were slaughtering the ship Grenil and the leader.
"Leader!"
Velekte threw a worried gaze at the sky. But before he could properly examine Ron's Sun, what filled his view was Linpa's falling greatsword.
The greatsword cut through Velekte's chest. His ears were cut off in the ensuing attack, and just before widening the distance, two of his toes fell off.
On the other hand, Linpa had not been injured at all.
"Now... die."
At the moment Linpa swung her sword to cut off Velekte's breath.
Graaaa...!
Kazijik-!
A roar of a person and a sharp noise of the Sun being 'torn' rang out from the sky.
It was the leader Kinzelo's roar.
Clearly coming from him, a crimson light was spreading within the cracks scattered throughout the Sun. It was the light of the red sword energy being emitted.
The Sun had shattered.
At last, Ron's secret skill, which was unleashed with all his might, was being broken by another person's sword under the sky of the Sword Emperor's Castle.

Like a receding wave, the light of the Sun and the red sword energy filling the sky began to fade. Even the spirit energy of Murakan, which had been dyeing the entire sky black, could not withstand the shock.
The sky quickly regained its original color.
In the middle of it, the shattered Grenil obscured the crescent moon, and the leader stood at the forefront.
It was no longer a blurry figure. It was the form of a demon that was very close to a human.
[Kuhuk...!]
His entire body was torn and shattered, barely recognizable. His body was so torn apart that it seemed as if half of it had disappeared, and he vomited blood.
Even his head, which was vomiting blood, had only half of it remaining, making it a hideously grotesque figure.
In front of the leader floated Murakan, crouching with his wings.
Flutter-!
As Murakan spread his wings, Ron Hairan, who had been hidden, was revealed. Unlike the leader, who had been torn to shreds while still alive, his injuries did not seem to have increased.
However, Jin, the knights, and Murakan knew.
The fact that if Ron continued to fight, he would suffer internal injuries that could be dangerous.

On the other hand, even as the leader's entire body was torn and vomiting blood, a sense of composure could be felt from somewhere. The ship Grenil, which he had been trying to protect, remained in the same state as when it was shattered by the great magic.
Hoo, hoo...
The leader took a rough breath and raised his steel sword with his remaining arm.
Then, a steel door larger than the ship Grenil filled the sky, and the knights tried to fly to prevent Grenil from heading towards the door.
However, Ron stopped them with his gaze. It was because they didn't know what would happen if the fight continued.
As if agreeing with Ron's judgment, the leader nodded his head, and as Grenil passed through the steel door, he looked down at Jin.
He then lifted half of his remaining mouth into a smile and leisurely exited through the steel door.
